Hi, I'm Alex!

Like most people, I love ice cream. Like few people, I care a lot about my macros and hitting my daily protein target. Once I learned I could make my own protein ice cream, it was only natural to make website as well.

Every flavor gets tested and tweaked until perfection. If it's still a 🚧 WIP, it's being worked on. Once it earns the ✅ Tried & True sticker, it's officially approved.

Remember that all my flavors prioritize macros over taste so manage your expectations!
